rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a supposition or proposition accepted without proof.

example.english: Let’s make an assumption first and see whether the plan will work.
example.traditional: 我哋先作個假設，睇吓個計劃行唔行得通。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 zok3 go3 gaa2 cit3 tai2 haa5 go3 gai3 waak6 hang4 m4 hang4 dak1 tung1

rows.note: Use this when the assumption is a preconceived or prejudiced belief, especially about a person.

example.english: Don’t make an assumption about the newcomer; give them a chance.
example.traditional: 唔好對新人有成見，畀佢一次機會啦。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 deoi3 san1 jan4 jau5 sing4 gin3 bei2 keoi5 jat1 ci3 gei1 wui6 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the assumption is a premise on which an argument, plan, or calculation is based.

example.english: This calculation is based on the assumption that everyone arrives on time.
example.traditional: 呢個計算有個前提，就係大家都準時到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 syun3 jau5 go3 cin4 tai4 zau6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zeon2 si4 dou3
